identity.evidence: Compared with canonical athlete-anatomy-v3: bald faceless white/grey anatomical figure, featureless pelvic centre, white trainers and fine outlines. Same figure retained through all poses.

camera.evidence: Same 1536x1024 canvas and three-quarter view throughout. Both fixed sole-front intersections drift at most one native pixel; their measured spans are unchanged.

anatomy.evidence: Inspected all three native poses and all six in the real player. Continuous limbs, hands, wrists and ankles; no extra limbs or clipping. Torso and legs lower together and return along the same sequence.

equipment.evidence: One modest plate on the upper back throughout. Its changing projected ellipse follows torso rotation; no plate additions, detached plate or visible sliding off the back.

contact.evidence: Both palms and toes remain planted visually, and the plate stays supported on the upper back. Sole measurements are attached. The near finger threshold differs by two native pixels; no visible sliding at the reviewed mobile scale. Palm bounding-box widths were not treated as invariant because those ROIs include the rotating wrist.

physics.evidence: High plank lowers through the midpoint into a low push-up and presses back without hip sag or plate separation. Elbows bend behind the hands. This is qualitative illustration review, not a calibrated measurement of joint angles or floor distance.

muscles.evidence: Pectorals retain the strongest purple, triceps and anterior deltoids lighter lilac, core a pale tint. No activation reversal on return; repeated poses are byte-identical pairs.

cueAgreement.evidence: Each exact weighted-push-ups beat matches its image: brace, lower, pause low, hold, press, reset. Plate placement/stability cues belong to this variation rather than the generic push-up set.

sequenceAndLoop.evidence: Real ExerciseFormFrames manually stepped 1→2→3→4→5→6→1; automatic advancement and pause observed. Frames 4=3, 5=2, 6=1 are intentional pause/return reuse.

mobileLight.evidence: Real ExerciseFormFrames with repository CSS/fonts at browser viewport 390x844: all six frames and loop visually inspected in light theme; captions readable, no clipping or horizontal overflow, all controls at least 44px high.

mobileDark.evidence: Same real component at 390x844 in actual dark theme: all six frames and loop inspected; captions readable, no clipping or horizontal overflow. Screenshots and accessibility evidence are preserved in the Codex task tool results.
